description: Interactive MCQ quiz tool for CBSE Grade 7 Mathematics (Decimals chapter — 'A Peek Beyond the Point'). Redesigned with Singularity Design System (Poppins font, #4A4DC9 primary, #FF7212 accent, #533086→#FC9145 gradient). 10 multiple-choice questions covering the entire chapter: fraction-to-decimal conversion, decomposition, descending order, digit puzzles, word problems, unit conversion, and comparisons. Each question shows 4 options with one correct. After answering, explanation appears with optional KaTeX math rendering in the explanation only (question-level KaTeX display has been removed). Options are shuffled. Score tracker shows correct/total. Geometric decorative shapes (circles, triangles, squares) from design system appear on intro and results screens.
chapter: Chapter 3 — A Peek Beyond the Point

teaching_notes: Use as chapter review quiz AFTER all practice topics. The 10 MCQs sample the most important concepts from Q1-Q16. Focus on Q4 (descending order) and Q5 (more-digits fallacy) as common misconceptions.
